## 实践与诊断（primary）

- [CPU、内存、磁盘、程序与进程](../book/volume-00-computer-foundations/chapters/ch.foundations.computer-process-model.md) — `ch.foundations.computer-process-model#build` · `primary` · 完成该章的独立构建任务：启动并观察一个短进程和一个持续进程，记录 PID、父进程、CPU/内存变化、可执行文件与磁盘文件之间的关系
- [线程、Java 内存模型、同步与锁](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.threads-jmm.md) — `ch.java-engineering.threads-jmm#build` · `primary` · 实现两个线程累加工单计数的错误版与 synchronized/Lock 正确版，用重复运行展示竞态和 happens-before
- [线程、Java 内存模型、同步与锁](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.threads-jmm.md) — `ch.java-engineering.threads-jmm#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入可见性标志不终止、check-then-act 丢更新和错误锁对象，抓线程状态后建立正确同步边
- [Executor、Future、取消与虚拟线程](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.executors-virtual-threads.md) — `ch.java-engineering.executors-virtual-threads#build` · `primary` · 完成该章的独立构建任务：用 Executor 提交带超时的独立维修查询任务，收集 Future 成功/异常/取消结果并对比虚拟线程版本
- [Executor、Future、取消与虚拟线程](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.executors-virtual-threads.md) — `ch.java-engineering.executors-virtual-threads#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入任务吞中断、Future 永久等待和 Executor 未关闭，利用线程/超时证据实现协作式取消
- [注解声明、目标、保留策略与元数据](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.annotations-metadata.md) — `ch.java-engineering.annotations-metadata#build` · `primary` · 声明 @RequiresRole 注解并设置 Target/Retention/可重复策略，同时解释此前 @Test 标记在运行时被发现的条件
- [注解声明、目标、保留策略与元数据](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.annotations-metadata.md) — `ch.java-engineering.annotations-metadata#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入 Retention=SOURCE、Target 错误和缺元注解导致运行时不可见，读取 class/反射观察后修复，并把异常定位到第一处可信证据
- [反射、类加载边界与动态代理](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.reflection-classloading-proxies.md) — `ch.java-engineering.reflection-classloading-proxies#build` · `primary` · 完成该章的独立构建任务：反射读取带 @RequiresRole 的方法并用 JDK Proxy 包装接口调用，记录类加载器、方法和委托链
- [反射、类加载边界与动态代理](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.reflection-classloading-proxies.md) — `ch.java-engineering.reflection-classloading-proxies#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入代理目标无接口、反射成员不可访问和上下文 ClassLoader 错误，定位边界后改为显式契约，并把异常定位到第一处可信证据
- [结构化日志、线程转储、JFR 与 JVM 故障诊断](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.logging-jvm-diagnostics.md) — `ch.java-engineering.logging-jvm-diagnostics#build` · `primary` · 完成该章的独立构建任务：为并发工单任务输出含 trace/order/thread 的结构化日志，并采集一次线程转储和短 JFR 记录关联症状
- [结构化日志、线程转储、JFR 与 JVM 故障诊断](../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.logging-jvm-diagnostics.md) — `ch.java-engineering.logging-jvm-diagnostics#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入线程阻塞、日志缺关联 ID 和敏感字段泄露，使用 dump/JFR/日志定位并加脱敏与上下文
